instruction: Locate the cracker box on the table, grasp it with a Dex3 hand and lift it at least 8 cm above its initial height while remaining standing. Use the visible box shape to distinguish it from distractors.
scene_contract: Native SIMPLE bend-pick task with a cracker-box target and table. MuJoCo objects can appear white without their original printed texture; identify geometry from fresh RGB rather than relying on package colors. Do not transfer the cube support plane, capsule model, coordinates or closure value without validation.
completion: Native reward is the clipped target height increase divided by 0.10 m, with threshold 0.8; the host reports native success. It has no grip-contact or dwell requirement.
Independently verify box-hand co-motion and visible retained support; a bumped or transiently tossed box may satisfy height without a secure grasp. Report those outcomes separately.
One independently reset success is required. Stop physical actions when rollout_finished and finish skill_update.
phase_guidance: Inspect current stereo RGB and robot state; identify the box, table boundaries, accessible narrow faces and whole-hand approach clearance. Resolve uncertain stereo matches before contact.
Select the relevant self-generated cube grasp experience and current shared method with experience_select. Adapt it to the larger rectangular box and native mesh fingers.
Arrange a collision-free approach using wrist pose and full distal-finger geometry. Prefer a visible approach; establish clearance before moving the fingers over the table surface.
Align thumb opposition against index/middle around a suitable cross-section. Close gradually and inspect fresh images; closure fractions are not aperture or force measurements.

Test a small lift with a stable grasp attitude. Require visible box-hand co-motion rather than equating wrist ascent with lifting the box. If it slips, reopen as appropriate and alter contact geometry before retrying.

Continue a confirmed grasp toward the requested lift height. Keep the box in view when possible and verify support until the host ends the attempt. If reach/tracking stalls, withdraw safely and record a different next hypothesis.
known_interface_limits: Checkpoint body PD, native SIMPLE hand meshes, 50 Hz tracker/200 Hz physics. One 0.5–3 s waypoint at a time; 0.03 m and 0.10 rad bounds. Simulation pauses during complete Astra/xhigh reasoning. Physical budget 240 s.
failure_guidance: Separate observation uncertainty, tracking, contact acquisition and task progress. Preserve public evidence, excluded hypotheses and a changed next test. finish_attempt only records a stall; it does not terminate the episode. Follow its returned current observation and next_call to test the changed safe hypothesis in this same episode. Continue until native success/failure, runtime safety/system termination or the physical budget. Do not use reasoning delay, three completed actions or temporary lack of progress as a stop condition. Do not consume remaining budget with idle holds.
prohibited_shortcuts: No object poses/contact truth, hidden reward query, task/evaluator source access, human/external demonstrations, replay as task credit or mid-episode reset.
guidance_status: Detailed task input and qualitative guidance; the actor chooses motion using current allowed observations.
